links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of LLM clinical content on orthopaedic procedures, incl. risks and alternatives
links.effect: Factual accuracy >90%, but 36% of responses contained misleading or incomplete information; surgical risk responses performed worst; mean DISCERN 43.5 (fair).
links.quote: Factual accuracy was high (>90%), but 36% of responses contained some misleading or incomplete information.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates ChatGPT-4o's performance (accuracy, completeness, DISCERN score) on patient-facing orthopaedic surgery queries using expert evaluation rubrics, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
